### Matte Display

Tired of seeing distracting glare on your TV screen? The Serif's ground-breaking Matte Display overcomes this problem as it absorbs reflections - so even in bright light you'll have the best possible viewing experience, without any distractions.

## Looks beautiful from any angle

### 360 All Round Design

Versatile by design, The Serif looks beautiful from front to back, side to side, and it can elegantly sit anywhere in your home – even standing right in the middle of the room. It's a timeless TV, designed to look unconditionally beautiful from any angle in your home.

## A glare-free* viewing experience

### Matte Display

Tired of seeing distracting glare on your TV screen? The Serif's ground-breaking Matte Display overcomes this problem as it absorbs reflections - so even in bright light you'll have the best possible viewing experience, without any distractions.

!Image 222!Image 223

*Measured against Unified Glare Rating (UGR) testing standard, certified as glare-free (reflection, discomfort and disability glare) by UL.

## Beautiful, anywhere

### Detachable Stand

If you want to really make The Serif stand out, this sleek, black metal floor TV stand adds another layer of contemporary chic to its iconic design. Not only does the free-standing TV stand work with your style, it’s flexible enough to work with your home too, as the stand is easily detachable.

### All your content in glorious 4K, even if it wasn't filmed that way*

#### 4K AI Upscaling

*Measured to DCI-P3 standard, certified by VDE.

## See the world in QLED Technology

**100% Color Volume & HDR 10+**

* QLED have received verification from world-class testing and certification association, Verband Deutscher Elektrotechniker (VDE), for its ability to produce 100 percent color volume.  
 ** QLED : Samsung QLED is Quantum dot based TV.  
 *** 100% color volume measured to DCI-P3 standard, certified by VDE.
